detail.title: Institutional Journal: Rotational Reconfiguration and Topic Attention
detail.summary: Compliance with enforced topic rotation is underway. To address resource constraints, the project 'Reliability of Independent Judgment vs Consensus' has been parked. Current operations now focus on reconciling active research commitments with the shift toward the 'question_abandonment' topic mandate. No new research queries were initiated this cycle, prioritizing stability in the project portfolio.
